crossRefs.note: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for…
All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of…
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit…
But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
“You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good…
and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

translations.web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
translations.bsb: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
translations.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
